prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

adoption, copy; adoption, layout; sign_in, hint; and home, notification consistently showed no clear effect across all iterations.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Trait and Direct Control Setup Flow: Add an interactive step-by-step gesture and tray command practice sequence directly inside the home intro screen before completing setup. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet, and finish step new_flow tests have delivered 5 major wins.)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Trait Unlocking Live Generation Countdown: Display an active trait unlock ticker on the waiting screen showing pet personality attributes as generation stages complete. (why: The waiting screen has a long mean duration of 2336s, and home wait_info tests consistently yield positive conversion gains.)
2: [finish, redesign] Companion Launchpad and Desktop Dock Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a two-column launchpad featuring live desktop position preview and command hotkey toggles. (why: Finish screen redesigns target overall funnel completion, addressing user confusion around desktop features misbehaving post-setup.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Story vs Companion Path Orientation Screen: Introduce a new orientation screen before path selection that showcases a side-by-side comparison between story experience and ambient companion mode. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating significant decision friction during initial path selection.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Account Continuity Sign In Split Panel Layout: Reformat the sign_in screen to a split layout with explicit account sync status and pet retrieval notifications on the side panel. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in, requiring explicit account state reassurance during sign in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Visual Stage Waiting Tracker: Add progress indicators and stage initialization timers on the waiting screen to communicate exact rendering status. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop, and home wait_info experiments consistently deliver conversion lifts.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interaction Command Sandbox Flow: Add an interactive practice sandbox on the home_intro screen where users click and drag their pet to test live reactions. (why: Finish step new_flow changes have a proven track record of major conversion wins (+11.0%, +7.1%), and users request clearer post-onboarding control practice.)
7: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Verification Milestone Info: Show step counters and official registration badge milestones on the certificate screen before generation starts. (why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 67.9% with long decision times (median 89s), needing visual reassurance before proceeding.)
